name: Spell Component Ring

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Holds one prepared spell's ordinary Material component, so you need no free hand to reach it.
text: As a Magic action you can store the Material component of one spell you have prepared in this ring, as long as it has no cost and isn't consumed. While you wear it, that spell needs no free hand for its Material component. (The game doesn't track free hands for components.)
